name: video_relight
description: Relight existing footage (Beeble SwitchLight). Either 1-4 `lights` with azimuth/elevation enums, or `lightTransferImage` to copy another image's lighting. Capped at 240 frames — longer sources are truncated. Then `creations_show`.

creationIdentifier.description: Completed owned video identifier. Exactly one of this or `videoUrl`.

firstFrameUrl.description: Start frame to relight: a creation identifier (bare or `creation:`-prefixed) or a Freepik URL. Required only with `videoUrl`; derived from the creation otherwise.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

lightTransferImage.description: Image whose lighting is copied onto the footage: a creation identifier (bare or `creation:`-prefixed) or a Freepik URL. Exactly one of this or `lights`.

lights.description: 1-4 lights. Exactly one of this or `lightTransferImage`.

videoUrl.description: Freepik video URL. Exactly one of this or `creationIdentifier`.
